skill.title: Guide Pip
skill.promise: You can guide Pip to a point.
skill.pipAbility: Pip can reach a marked point.

lessons.title: Reach the mark

screens.prompt: Pip starts at (1, 1). The mark is right and up. First you...

options.label: Move left, away from the mark

feedback.wrong_option: The mark has a direction from the start. Aim there.

screens.correctMessage: The first move points at the mark.

screens.prompt: Guide Pip from (1, 1) onto the mark.

feedback.wrong_direction: The mark is up and to the right.
feedback.wrong_length: The aim is right. Match the distance to the mark.

screens.prompt: The mark is 3 right of x = 2. Set x.

feedback.too_low: Start at 2 and step right. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: Three steps right of 2 is not that far. Move lower.

screens.prompt: The mark is 2 up from y = 3. Set y.

feedback.too_low: Start at 3 and climb. Move up.
feedback.too_high: Two steps up from 3 is lower than that. Move down.

screens.prompt: The move that reached the mark is what?

options.label: An arrow with length and direction
Only the name of the mark

feedback.wrong_option: A name does not say how far or which way. The move does.

screens.correctMessage: You guided Pip with an arrow.

screens.prompt: From (1, 1), Pip must go 4 right and 2 up.

feedback.wrong_direction: The step goes right and up.
feedback.wrong_length: The run is 4 and the rise is 2.

screens.correctMessage: That step aims at the target.

lessons.whyItMatters: Reaching a target is the shape of a training step.
